g.text: Melanie Lynskey Dispels ‘Two and a Half Men’ Pay Rumors: ‘There Is This Insane Idea That I Made Millions of Dollars’ ◆ Jon Stewart Slams Haley Stevens’ Mike Rogers Endorsement Ahead of Election Day ◆ Disney Expected to Lay Off Thousands of Staffers in Biggest Round of Cuts This Year ◆ Elena Maganini, Film Editor on ‘Dexter,’ ‘Henry, Portrait of a Serial Killer,’ Dies at 70 ◆ Cynthia Nixon Says She ‘Loved’ Miranda’s Attempts to Become ‘Woke’ on ‘And Just Like That’ Despite Fans Being ‘Horrified’ ◆ New Japanese Animation Prize Named Nippon Anime Awards, Sets First Ceremony for November 2027 ◆
